parameters.name: HostGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the asset group to be deleted.
> You can call the [ListHostGroups](~~201307~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host to which the asset group to be deleted belongs.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the asset group to be deleted belongs.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
